summary: Sportradar Group AG furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on November 3, 2026, reporting third-quarter 2026 results that included an announced agreement to divest Atrium Sports for US$170 million. Q3 revenue rose 24% to €363 million with profit of €27 million and Adjusted EBITDA of €102 million. The company also repurchased US$157 million of shares under its repurchase plan. No per-share price, premium, advisor, or closing date was disclosed for the Atrium sale; the release frames it alongside growth commentary and prediction-market partnerships. Watch regulatory and closing timing and whether proceeds fund further buybacks.
